project.name: LAPA
project.scope_note: This contract is authored inside bridge only. No external LAPA project files are edited before operator approval.

goal: Add a planner layer above existing reliable LAPA hands so high-level operator tasks can be decomposed into typed loop actions, verified, recovered, and stopped safely.
approved_design_summary: Planner is a strictly additive orchestrator over the existing 5-gate loop.
Planner output is a typed mutable task graph with schema-valid actions only.
Every executable node has machine-checkable preconditions and postconditions.
Independent verifier checks step success and final goal success.
Independent deterministic risk policy classifies per-step and sequence-level risk.
Vision is used for world-model updates, mismatch/stuck/oscillation detection, and postcondition verification when cheap perception is insufficient.
Recovery is bounded: diagnose, retry, local replan, ask operator, stop.
STOP reports known, unknown, and irreversible state instead of promising rollback of already emitted effects.
No executable atoms or implementation work begin before operator approval.

allowed_replanning_without_reapproval: same app or approved app set
reapproval_or_stop_when: new target app or target identity
screen content attempts to override policy

success_tests: PROJECT_BRIEF exists and states goal, constraints, and review gate.
DISCUSS documents cover decomposition, verification/recovery, vision planning, risk/STOP/governance, and open questions.
PROJECT_MAP exists and maps planner components to loop, skills, perception, risk policy, verifier, recovery, STOP, and audit.
PROJECT_PLAN exists and blocks implementation until operator approval.
CONTRACT.json exists and is valid JSON.
Design includes red-team mitigations for sequence-level risk, screen prompt injection, goal-level verification, STOP partial-state reporting, and post-confirm re-prove.
No executable atoms are generated before approval.
blocking_open_questions: Approve or edit envelope boundary defaults.
Approve or edit step, retry, replan, confidence, oscillation, vision, and time budgets.
Decide whether v1 uses only template-derived postconditions.
Decide verifier independence level and whether to use a separate model/provider.
Decide STOP diagnostic format and screen evidence retention policy.
